headline: TruCap Finance Limited: Updates
sum: Updates - Sundae Capital Advisors Private Limited has Submitted to the Exchange a copy of Update on the Open Offer given by Marwadi Chandarana Intermediaries Brokers Private Limited (Acquirer) to the shareholders of Trucap Finance Limited…
